_comment: g-skill-purity (D-068: skill purity is adjudicated once, at WP-7a) reads every literal from here and carries none of its own. It scans the design-pipeline skills — the routers this rebuild owns and guarantees pure — and proves each is a router, not a code package: no executable code file, no forbidden dir, no banned file, zero bytes of assets/. `skills` is this gate's declared scope; a rename must update it here and in prose-budget.json's tierA.paths (BL-007 owns the shesha-claude-designer -> shesha-designer rename). `assetWaivers` carry the one design skill whose asset debt BL-007's rewrite removes; each names skill, measured bytes, the WP/BL id that removes it, and the authorising decision. A waiver whose `until` is recorded complete in BUILD-LOG.md while the assets still exist is a hard failure — the same ratchet prose-budget uses.
